answer: Identity-bond decay blocks fake identities. Each agent posts a bond of twice its 30-day reward, decaying 5% per epoch unless one verified task refreshes it. A garden of agents needs ongoing work, not one payment. Making 100 fakes costs 100 bonds; idle ones bleed 5% per epoch, so the attacker's bill grows while an agent pays once for undiluted reward. The ripple from a caught cluster forfeits its bonds, and a nebula of copies fades before voting.
